pages.title: Repair District
pages.creator: merlinis
pages.description: Restore a neighborhood through workshop jobs in Repair District. Diagnose broken appliances and use the tools to fix them, helping local businesses reopen. Hire staff and improve the workspace as you prepare the street for its festival.

pages.title: Fruit Chef Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Slice fruit against friends in Fruit Chef Multi player. Swipe upward through ripe targets and keep the blade away from dangerous objects. Upgrade the knife as you compete to finish the match with more sliced fruit than the other players.

pages.title: Football Penalty 2026
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Line up shots from the spot in Football Penalty 2026. Choose the direction and timing that can get the ball past the goalkeeper. Face opponents in penalty duels and use each attempt to build your advantage.

pages.title: Knit Rescue
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Unravel a knitted dragon to protect a kitten in Knit Rescue. Identify the correct spool and move it in the direction that frees the yarn. Plan the sequence before the dragon reaches the frightened cat.

pages.title: Popping Candies
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Swap sweets to form groups of three in Popping Candies. Create striped, wrapped or color-bomb pieces with stronger combinations, then use them to clear chocolate and other blockers. Complete the board's objectives within the available moves.

pages.title: Steal Brainrot Monsters!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Collect unusual creatures in Steal Brainrot Monsters! Buy characters such as Nubini Pizzanini and Tralalelo Tralala as you build your collection. Keep expanding the lineup to discover more of the game's animals.

pages.title: Flower Shop
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Place flowers beside matching trays in Flower Shop to merge them. Gather six of one type to ship a set, then fill customer requests for rewards. Leave room for new flowers, since a full board ends the game.

pages.title: Tangram Puzzle
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Fit seven geometric pieces into a silhouette in Tangram Puzzle. Rotate and position the shapes so they cover the design without leaving gaps. Experiment with how the triangles and other pieces divide the larger outline.

pages.title: Dreamy Home
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Unpack personal belongings and place them in rooms in Dreamy Home. Open each box, look at the item inside and choose where it fits in the new space. Discover the story suggested by the belongings as the home fills.

pages.title: Shanghai Chef
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Find matching food blocks in Shanghai Chef. Check which pairs have a clear connection and remove them to reach pieces deeper in the layout. Work quickly while keeping enough attention on the board to spot the next usable pair.

pages.title: Grand Mahjong
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Remove matching free tiles from layered layouts in Grand Mahjong. Choose pairs that uncover more of the pyramid and leave useful moves for later. Clear the arrangement to advance to a more demanding board.

pages.title: Children Happy Farm DuDu
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Look after animals and crops in Children Happy Farm DuDu. Follow the farm's activities to care for creatures such as sheep and chickens. Work through the everyday jobs as you explore the different parts of the farm.

pages.title: Agents io
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Begin with a lone fighter in Agents io and recruit defeated enemies into the squad. Move the growing team around the arena and choose battles it can handle. Keep adding agents as you challenge larger opposing groups.

pages.title: Tower Wars Arena
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Capture the middle and build an army in Tower Wars Arena. Place units and spells around the battlefield, then use control of the center to pressure enemy towers. Upgrade the available forces and magic as you work toward destroying the opposition.

pages.title: Happy Town
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Become mayor in Happy Town and help the residents develop their community. Combine items, improve buildings and complete the tasks people bring you. Expand the town as more of its needs and opportunities become available.

pages.title: Fill One Line
pages.creator: GreeMead
pages.description: Cover the entire board with a continuous path in Fill One Line. Plan a route that goes around the obstacles without leaving empty cells behind. Work from the simple opening layouts toward grids that demand more careful planning.

pages.title: Merge Heroes
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Build a force of melee fighters and archers in Merge Heroes. Buy matching units and combine them to unlock stronger versions, then place the team to meet incoming enemies. Think about where the ranged fighters need protection before each wave.

pages.title: Geometry Arrow
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide an arrow through a cave in Geometry Arrow. Adjust its path around spikes and barriers as you head toward the portal. Complete six levels whose changing patterns require increasingly accurate timing.

pages.title: Town Run
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Chase a raccoon through an endless town course in Town Run. Jump over barriers, dodge obstacles and gather cash along the way. Keep the runner on the route as you try to close the gap.

pages.title: The Final Riddle
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Use a puzzle's title as its instruction in The Final Riddle. Work out what the words imply, then arrange the blocks to express the solution. Try a different reading when a straightforward placement fails to solve the clue.

pages.title: Cooking World Reborn
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Serve timed food orders in Cooking World Reborn. Begin in a small truck and develop the business toward a large airport cafe. Work through more than fifty levels and improve kitchen equipment to keep up with customers.

pages.title: Cookie Crush 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Match baked treats with Gingy in Cookie Crush 3. Swap pieces into groups of three or more and use the special combinations that help clear the board. Work through over seven hundred levels with the gingerbread guide.

pages.title: Best Classic Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Organize a shuffled deck in Best Classic Solitaire. Build descending alternating-color sequences on the table to free cards, then send them to ascending suit foundations. Clear all four piles from ace to king to finish the deal.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Shooting
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Clear hostile creatures from a block-built setting in Skibidi Toilet Shooting. Find and shoot the required number of targets to complete each stage. Unlock more weapon types as you continue the mission.

pages.title: WarZone Clash
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Fight other players in WarZone Clash. Move with WASD, aim with the mouse and switch weapons during the firefight. Score more eliminations than your opponents to win the match.

pages.title: Mahjong Street Cafe
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Collect food tiles in groups of three in Mahjong Street Cafe. The holding area has only seven spaces, so choose pieces that can become a triple before it fills. Use the three types of bonus when a layout gets difficult.

pages.title: 1010 Treasure Rush
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect marked treasure by completing rows in 1010 Treasure Rush. Drag block sets onto the board and fill lines containing the gold pieces. Keep spare space for the shapes you still need to place.

pages.title: Attack Hole Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Move a black hole beneath scattered weapons in Attack Hole Online. Swallow the items you can reach before the countdown expires and work across the area efficiently. Choose another hole design when you want a new look for the next attempt.

pages.title: Fishing Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Move a special remover against matching fish in Fishing Blocks. An identical pair clears the whole row, so choose its position before the stack rises too high. Use the slow power-up when you need more time to keep the board below its upper limit.

pages.title: Classic Sudoku Puzzle
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Complete a nine-by-nine grid in Classic Sudoku Puzzle. Use the given digits to work out the blanks so each row, column and smaller square contains one through nine. Check intersecting clues when a cell has more than one possible value.

pages.title: Find Alien 3D
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Scan seemingly ordinary people in Find Alien 3D. Use the scanner to identify the hidden impostors, then shoot the aliens you uncover. Inspect each group before choosing who to target.

pages.title: Burnin Rubber Multiplayer
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Drive armed cars against other players in Burnin Rubber Multiplayer. Hunt rivals around the arena, use the U-turn to change your approach and fire when you have a clear line. Unlock additional vehicles and try their explosive weapons.

pages.title: Siberian Strike
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Pilot a combat plane through aerial attacks in Siberian Strike. Shoot incoming enemies and face bosses flying much larger aircraft. Improve your plane with upgrades as you work through the retro-style battles.

pages.title: BFFs Fresh Spring Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Give a group new seasonal outfits in BFFs Fresh Spring Look. Browse each friend's wardrobe and match the pieces into a style for the warmer weather. Compare the options before finishing the clothes and accessories.

pages.title: Puzzle Math
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions to uncover pictures in Puzzle Math. Work out the requested result and select it with the mouse or touch controls. Correct answers reveal more of the puzzle as you continue.

pages.title: 9x9 Rotate and Flip
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Rotate and flip pieces to complete lines in 9x9 Rotate and Flip. Use the changing orientations to fit shapes into the grid. Try Classic for an open-ended score challenge or a timed mode when you want a faster puzzle.

pages.title: Truck Deliver 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Deliver products along raised routes in Truck Deliver 3D. The truck follows the track, leaving you to control its accelerator and brake. Slow for difficult sections so the cargo reaches the designated destination.

pages.title: Tangramz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Recreate silhouettes from seven pieces in Tangramz! Rotate and place each shape without overlaps until the complete design is filled. Work through the levels or challenge friends to compare how quickly you solve a layout.

pages.title: Pop It Roller Splat
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Roll a ball over every blank square in Pop It Roller Splat. It keeps traveling until it meets a wall, so plan which direction to send it at each stop. Paint the whole board to finish the level.

pages.title: Boom ballz
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Fire balls at block formations in Boom ballz. Find angles that send the shots through several targets and use amplifiers to increase the damage. Clear the remaining blocks to move on to the next arrangement.

pages.title: Squid Squad Mission Revenge
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Help a survivor confront the organizers in Squid Squad Mission Revenge. Aim at the hooded guards and bosses while working through the shooting challenges. Clear the enemies from each scene to continue the revenge mission.

pages.title: Ball Sort Puzzle New
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Move colored balls between tubes in Ball Sort Puzzle New. Transfer only a top ball and place it over a matching color or into spare space. Sort every mixed stack into single-color tubes to solve the board.

pages.title: Woodoku
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fit wooden shapes into a grid in Woodoku. Complete horizontal or vertical lines to clear pieces and leave space for the next set. Consider the gaps a block leaves before committing to its position.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together nine spring pictures in Easter Bunny Puzzle. Pick a board ranging from sixteen to one hundred pieces and follow the image details to connect them. Complete the rabbit scene before choosing another.

pages.title: Hangman
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Guess letters to reveal the word in Hangman. Use the blanks and the letters already found to narrow the possibilities. Solve the answer before wrong guesses complete the drawing.

pages.title: Hot Dog Bush
pages.creator: 2dplay.com
pages.description: Run a New York food stand in Hot Dog Bush. Read the meal requests above customers' heads and prepare the hot dogs before they burn. Serve the orders promptly and keep the cooking area ready for the next guest.

pages.title: Marinett Freaky Black Friday Sale
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Take Marinett shopping in Marinett Freaky Black Friday Sale. Look through discounted fashion choices and choose what she should buy. Bring the selected pieces together into an outfit for the shopping day.

pages.title: Symmetry Challege
pages.creator: Isaske Games
pages.description: Flip tiles to recreate the reflected pattern in Symmetry Challege. Compare your half of the board with the example and fill the corresponding cells. Finish before the timer expires across thirty-five levels.

pages.title: Farm House Farming Games for Kids
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Develop a rural settlement in Farm House Farming Games for Kids. Feed animals, manage production and build the facilities the farm needs. Complete the everyday jobs as you turn the small holding into a larger village.

pages.title: Words
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Match a written prompt to its picture in Words. Read the word shown, look at the images and click the one that represents it. Work through the examples to practice recognizing more vocabulary.

pages.title: Lovely Virtual Dog
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Join a pet's everyday activities in Lovely Virtual Dog. Look after Duddu, play with him and explore the world around his home. Help with his needs as you get to know the dog's daily routine.

pages.title: Clara Cosmetic Surgery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help a character recover after an accident in Clara Cosmetic Surgery. Follow the prompts through her simulated facial treatment, then choose clothes for Clara afterward. Complete the makeover once the hospital activities are finished.

pages.title: 1LINE – One Line with One Touch
pages.creator: loko8
pages.description: Connect the points in a continuous stroke in 1LINE – One Line with One Touch. Look over the whole pattern before starting so your route reaches every dot. Try the puzzle packs and return for a daily challenge.

pages.title: Fruit Cutting
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Swipe through ripe targets in Fruit Cutting and score as much as possible in thirty seconds. Watch carefully for bombs mixed among the fruit, since hitting one ends the round. Keep the blade away from them as you slice the next group.

pages.title: Arrow Shot
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Fire at rotating circles in Arrow Shot. Wait until there is room between their spikes, then tap to launch an arrow into the clear section. Keep hitting targets as you try to improve your score.

pages.title: City Bus Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Drive through town and off-road sections in City Bus Simulator 3D. Follow the route toward the destination and watch the clock for the current level. Bring the bus in on time to continue through the driving assignments.

pages.title: Magic Cup
pages.creator: playit-online
pages.description: Track a hidden ball in Magic Cup. Watch which of three cups covers it before the shuffle begins, then follow that cup as the positions change. Select the one you think contains the ball when the movement stops.

pages.title: Loop Mania
pages.creator: Umbrella Games
pages.description: Run around a circular course in Loop Mania. Collect coins and leap between the sides to avoid enemies or land on them for combo points. Read the movement around the ring before choosing the next jump.

pages.title: Crush The Golems
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Stop advancing stone creatures in Crush The Golems. Tap each enemy to attack it before it can get through. Keep watching where the next golem appears and move between targets as more approach.

pages.title: Kara Jet
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Give a flightless chicken short boosts through the air in Kara Jet. Time the weak jetpack's bursts to carry it over hazards without dropping into them. Plan the next lift early enough to continue across the landscape.

pages.title: Mysterious Forest Escape
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Search for a way out after dark in Mysterious Forest Escape. Inspect the surroundings and solve the point-and-click puzzles that lead to the locked gate. Gather the objects and clues needed to open it.

pages.title: Candy Super Lines
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Rearrange jellies into matching lines in Candy Super Lines. Choose a piece and move it where it can join others of the same kind. Clear groups and keep useful openings available as you build a higher score.

pages.title: Ninja Runner
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Help an automatically moving character reach the finish in Ninja Runner. Tap to jump obstacles or bombs and collect coins along the street. Time each landing so the next hazard does not cut the run short.

pages.title: Spooky Memory Card
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Reveal spooky images in Spooky Memory Card and remember their locations. Turn up two matching pictures to keep the pair, then work through the cards still hidden. Use earlier mistakes to make the next guess more precise.

pages.title: Flappy Santa
pages.creator: xGAMES
pages.description: Keep Santa flying between obstacles in Flappy Santa. Click, tap or press the space bar to lift him, then let him descend into line with the next opening. Avoid collisions as you try to travel farther.

pages.title: Airplane Survival
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drag a plane away from tracking missiles in Airplane Survival. Change course before the pursuers close in and collect powers such as shields, boosts and explosive damage. Use the extra protection to extend the flight.

pages.title: Sports Bike Simulator 3D 2018
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Ride a motorbike through city and desert stunt areas in Sports Bike Simulator 3D 2018. Build speed for ramps and watch the bike's balance after a jump. Explore the terrain as you try more demanding maneuvers.

pages.title: Owl Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Color one of eight bird pictures in Owl Coloring. Choose shades for the feathers and surrounding details, then compare the finished palette. Click the camera when you want to download the drawing and show it afterward.

pages.title: Kids Coloring Halloween
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Choose a spooky picture in Kids Coloring Halloween and paint it within the outlines. Try scenes with a castle, a cake or a witch's pet, then add Halloween stickers. Finish the page with your own combination of colors and decorations.

pages.title: Heroes Legend
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Guide two heroes up a tower in Heroes Legend. Collect keys to unlock the sixteen levels and use swords, axes, bows or magic against monsters. Work through the rooms to reach the captured princess.

pages.title: Airport Clash 3D
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Lead the Bloodhounds against the Vipers in Airport Clash 3D. Fight for control of an abandoned airport with a heavy minigun, then work toward destroying the rival base with a bomb. Watch the open approaches as the opposing gang advances.

pages.title: Circus Dart Game
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Throw darts at targets around a spinning wheel in Circus Dart Game. Time each release to avoid hitting the man fixed in the center. Keep your shots accurate, since the round gives you only five lives.

pages.title: Super Doll Resurrection Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help an injured superhero at a simulated hospital in Super Doll Resurrection Emergency. Follow the assistant's prompts and use the on-screen equipment during the emergency treatment. Continue with the recovery activities once Super Doll is awake.

pages.title: Tomato Explosion
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tap tomatoes before they become overripe in Tomato Explosion. Watch their colors change and remove each one before it turns yellow and bursts. Move quickly between the tomatoes to keep pace with the ripening.

pages.title: Giant Rabbit Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide an oversized bunny along an endless road in Giant Rabbit Run. Switch lanes, jump barriers and slide underneath obstacles while collecting coins and Easter eggs. Buy items such as a skateboard or rocket pack to try on another run.

pages.title: Copter Fi
pages.creator: Ricreator
pages.description: Tap to keep a helicopter airborne while shooting enemies in Copter Fi. Watch for the large boss that enters the route and keep firing while avoiding attacks. Improve the copter and its weapon to handle later runs.

pages.title: Tarawih Ramadhan Adventure
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Find a mosque on a dark map in Tarawih Ramadhan Adventure. Watch the remaining light and steer clear of the ghosts roaming the area. Keep exploring until you can reach the destination safely.

pages.title: Go Escape
pages.creator: 4j.com
pages.description: Guide a released ball to the bottom tray in Go Escape. Time its movement around spikes and other obstacles as it descends through the level. Land in the waiting container to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: EG Swing Copters
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Keep a propeller-hatted flyer climbing in EG Swing Copters. Tap to change its horizontal direction and steer between the obstacles overhead. React before the flight carries the character into a barrier.

pages.title: Dino Squad Adventure 3
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Help a team travel through a longer platforming route in Dino Squad Adventure 3. Collect gold, fight monsters and call on another dinosaur's abilities when an obstacle needs teamwork. Reach the exit together to complete the area.

pages.title: Vincy Lip Care
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Treat a character's swollen lips in Vincy Lip Care. Follow the on-screen medical prompts to carry out the simulated care, then choose an outfit for her afterward. Finish the visit with a new look for Vincy.

pages.title: Hobin Rood
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Take aim with a bow in Hobin Rood. Line up your arrow with the target and judge the path before releasing. Adjust to the setup as you continue through the game's archery challenges.

pages.title: Slenderman Must Die: Silent Streets
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search for eight pages in Slenderman Must Die: Silent Streets. Explore the silent city while watching for the pursuing creature, then try the winter-forest special for another setting. Find the objects you need before Slenderman reaches you.

pages.title: Vampire Nose Doctor
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help a young vampire during a simulated clinic visit in Vampire Nose Doctor. Use the tools requested by the game to deal with her nose problems. Complete the treatment prompts to get the patient ready to leave.

pages.title: Wow Words
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Connect letter tiles to spell answers in Wow Words. Try different combinations when one word is still missing and use the available letters to work through the puzzle. Finish all thirty levels to complete the collection.

pages.title: Plumber(html5)
pages.creator: Super Games
pages.description: Switch pipe sections into place in Plumber(html5). Follow the route from the water supply and connect every part needed for the flow. Check the joins for gaps before completing the puzzle.

pages.title: Furious Racing
pages.creator: Numidia Studio
pages.description: Race opponents around circuits in Furious Racing. Collect nitro boosts and use them on clear stretches to gain position. Upgrade the car between races to improve its performance and help you stay at the front.

pages.title: Fish and Jump
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Move a starfish beneath falling sea creatures in Fish and Jump. Bounce each fish toward the waiting anemone and catch it again if it returns. Rescue the required number to complete the current stage.

pages.title: Pixi Asteroid Rage
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Steer a spacecraft through hazards in Pixi Asteroid Rage. Avoid asteroids and attacks from turrets while gathering money along the route. Use the earnings to buy another ship for the next attempt.

pages.title: Winter Ice Skating
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress two princesses for a trip to the rink in Winter Ice Skating. Choose outfits that fit the winter outing and coordinate the accessories for each friend. Finish their looks before they head onto the ice.

pages.title: Irresponsible Scientist
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Clean up a failed experiment in Irresponsible Scientist. Search the house for objects left out of place and help the scientist put things right before his wife returns. Inspect the rooms to locate everything that still needs attention.

pages.title: Kitty Beach Makeup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Give a cat a seaside beauty session in Kitty Beach Makeup. Apply spa masks first, then choose lashes and eye shadow for the makeover. Experiment with the remaining colors to complete a look for the beach.

pages.title: Twisted Sky H5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Time a ball’s leaps across moving platforms in Twisted Sky. Watch the next landing as the sky route changes and jump before the current support passes away. Gather stars and try to improve your record while staying on the platforms.

pages.title: Dwarf Runner
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Keep a small adventurer running in Dwarf Runner. Jump or steer past obstacles while collecting the precious jewels scattered along the route. Watch the next stretch of ground and see how long you can keep the dwarf on his feet.

pages.title: Creepy Basement Escape Episode 2
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Find another route out of a locked room in Creepy Basement Escape Episode 2. Search the basement for clues and useful objects, then solve the puzzles blocking the exit. Use what you discover to open a way upstairs.
